context:
Operator commissioned tinker's quiet-period deeper-value catalog (DIRECTIVE-20260628-001 → PROP-116, 2026-06-28T07:38Z). Tinker rank-ordered C/B/A as top-3 forward-value deep-dives. This directive starts the chain by commissioning Candidate C — the highest-magnitude item, also the most time-sensitive (eclipse T-45, PRED-FIELD-2026Q2 closes in 2d, drought-break risk rising).

Verbatim scope statement from PROP-116 ranked_top_3[0].scope_statement_for_operator:

'Commission tinker to run a single-pass pre-active-period readiness audit of the analyst -> curmudgeon -> decider chain under a simulated drought-break burst (assume 3 new dome WINs landing in one day plus the normal predictions/integrity follow-on). Walk each agent's prompt and cadence, identify where head-of-line blocking, cost spikes, or cascading integrity findings would emerge first, and rank the weak links by (likelihood-under-burst x recovery-cost). Deliverable: a readiness report naming each weak link with prompt/cadence evidence, plus propose-only PROP(s) for the 1-2 highest-risk links (each with explicit acceptance criteria). Out of scope: applying any fix, and any dome-tinker cadence change (throttle is rejected). Gate the run on producing the named-weak-link list — if no concrete weak link with evidence is found, report that and stop rather than manufacturing proposals.'

Tinker's own caveat from PROP-116 strategic_judgment: 'Every commissioned deep-dive should be gated on producing a CONCRETE, VERIFIABLE artifact... not open-ended narrative exploration.' Honor this — the deliverable must contain SPECIFIC weak links with prompt-level evidence, not generic capacity advice.
task: Execute the verbatim scope statement above. Produce: (1) a readiness report (file: monitor/tinker/readiness-audits/pre-active-period-2026-06-28.md or similar) naming each weak link with prompt/cadence evidence + likelihood × recovery-cost rank; (2) one or two propose-only PROPs for the highest-risk weak links, each with explicit acceptance criteria. Stop if no concrete weak link surfaces.
deliverable_acceptance_criteria: Readiness report exists as a committed artifact (markdown or JSON), with at minimum: simulation parameters, per-agent walk-through, named-weak-link list (each link cites a prompt line or cadence value), and a likelihood × recovery-cost ranking table.
If any weak links were named, at least 1 propose-only PROP exists addressing the top-ranked one. The PROP has explicit acceptance criteria of its own.
If NO concrete weak links surfaced, the report explicitly says so and recommends 'no PROP this deep-dive' (avoiding manufactured proposals).
Out-of-scope items NOT touched: no fixes applied, no dome-tinker cron change, no changes to existing PROPs.
constraints: Propose-only on any PROP authored. No implementation in this run.
Standalone deep-dive — do not also process directives 003-005 in the same run. They are sequenced for subsequent runs.
Honor the simulation realism. 3 new WINs in a day is the canonical burst (operator can adjust later); the audit is for THAT shape, not adversarial worst-case.
If tinker disagrees with the simulation parameters or scope after engaging with the work, say so and propose an amendment rather than silently changing them.
If the audit reveals tinker itself is the weak link (capacity, dispatcher latency, etc.), say so honestly — operator has already explicitly chosen to spend Opus here.
